{{Quote|This 'charred scrap' is a piece of the droid that sabotaged my starfighter.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Runaway Starfighter" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], a '''droid''' was planted on the [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|starfighter]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] by the [[Thax's agent|agent]] of Separatist [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Thax]] to sabotage the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] in an attempt to discredit the Republic in the [[Mission to Themis|negotiations]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Themis]].<ref name="Runaway Starfighter" />
